craft_notes: Sthāyin: guru saying. Rows: melting then prize. Rejected: paraphrasing as doctrine — killed: ascribed saying kept. Read aloud: melting close.

lines: Steeped in supreme-spell That-ness, beast-stain gone,
the whole net of bonds by devotion's taste undone — what heart abides therein is highest prize: so our masters.
l4.sanskrit_cite: paramantratanmayībhāvāviṣṭasya nivṛttapaśuvāsanākalaṅkasya bhaktirasānuvedhavidrutasamastapāśajālasya yat adhivasati hṛdayaṃ tad eva paramam upādeyam iti asmadguravaḥ
